description: UCL Student Union Activity Registration Form (ARF). The president or treasurer must submit one at least 10 working days ahead, and earlier for bigger activity (8 weeks for tours, trips abroad and large campus events; 6 for balls and large off-campus events; 4 for spectator sport, controversial speakers and catered events; 2 for socials and workshops), when the activity spends over £350, raises money for charity, is high-risk, is run with an external organisation, UCL department or non-affiliated group, staff have asked for one, or it isn't regularly-held activity. Nothing else for the activity is approved, and it can't be promoted, until the ARF is. It records proposed dates/times/locations and a budget: expenditure lines and income lines (how each cost is covered), which must make a profit or break even and include a 15% contingency; ticket income is a breakdown of price x projected sales, never more than 50% of capacity. A payment request or ticket request can link to a submission of this form.
